description: API functions for the LLM Gateway — query routing, backend management, and log inspection.

functions.name: routeQuery
functions.description: Routes a query to the most appropriate backend based on classification and availability.

inputs.name: overrideBackendId
inputs.description: Optional backend override. If provided, bypasses classification and routes directly.

output.description: The routed query with status updated to COMPLETED.

errors.condition: The overrideBackendId does not match any configured backend.

functions.name: cancelQuery
functions.description: Cancels an in-flight query. Only queries in PENDING or ROUTED status can be cancelled.

inputs.name: queryId
inputs.description: The ID of the query to cancel.

output.description: The cancelled query with status updated to FAILED.

errors.condition: No query exists with this ID.
The query has already completed or been cancelled.

output.description: The backend with its current availability status.

errors.condition: No backend exists with this ID.

functions.name: listBackends
functions.description: Lists all configured backends with their availability status.

output.description: All configured backends sorted by priority.

functions.name: getQueryHistory
functions.description: Retrieves past query log entries, optionally filtered by backend or time range.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

output.description: Past query log entries sorted by most recent first.
The query with its current status and routing metadata.

errors.condition: No query exists with this ID.
